author: SickProdigy
description: A nostalgic catching RPG with activity encounters, battles, progression, retro scenes, a modular interactive Pokédex, Kanto Gyms, and persistent badges.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, globally owned Pokémon, party selections, inventory counts, persistent Pokémon health/status, badges, healing-item counts, catch provenance, active battles, and guild/channel spawn and Pokémon Center configuration. User deletion removes the requesting user's collection and active encounters.
install_msg: Configure an opt-in channel with `[p]pokemon set channel #channel`, then choose a starter with `[p]pokemon starter bulbasaur`. This is an unofficial noncommercial prototype.
name: Pokemon
short: Global Pokémon catching and wild battles
